visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair stands in a brightly lit indoor room with plain white walls. She wears a cream-colored knit top featuring black lace trim and a bow detail. Her face is centered in a medium close-up, and she speaks enthusiastically to the camera, using animated hand gestures to emphasize her points. (2) The screen splits to show a side-by-side comparison of the woman's face, labeled '20 days ago' and '20 days later'. The shots are extreme close-ups focusing on skin texture and brightness. Various colorful emojis like party poppers and clapping hands appear as overlays alongside yellow text banners. (3) The setting changes to a bathroom with large white tiles. The woman is wearing a white button-up camisole. She turns her head and body to display her skin from different angles under bright studio-style lighting. Pink and white text captions occupy the lower half of the frame. (4) In a kitchen or dining area, the woman holds a large cream-colored tumbler and drinks through a straw. She looks directly at the lens while subtitles explain her internal health routine. The background is slightly out of focus but shows typical home interior elements. (5) The camera focuses on three orange and white skincare bottles from the brand Paula's Choice, arranged on a white surface. The labels are clearly visible. The shot is static and clean, emphasizing the product packaging and brand identity against the neutral background. (6) A series of fast-paced clips show the woman applying liquid serums and lotions from the orange bottles onto her face, neck, and forearms. She uses circular motions with her fingers to blend the product. High-density text overlays describe the specific ingredients and benefits of each step. (7) The video transitions to an office setting where the woman sits at a table covered with green Mahjong tiles. She celebrates a winning hand with high energy, raising her hands. The products are displayed on the table beside the tiles, linking her bright skin to her good luck. (8) The final scene features the woman holding up the set of three skincare products. She points towards the screen with a smile. Large red and white text banners appear at the bottom, detailing the promotional dates and discount percentages for the upcoming sale.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long reddish-brown hair. She initially wears a cream-colored knit top with black lace trim and later a white button-up camisole.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video moves between a brightly lit indoor space with white walls, a bathroom with tiled walls, a kitchen area, and a brightly lit office where she plays Mahjong.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched and energetic female narration begins immediately. She speaks with a friendly and fast-paced delivery style. Concurrently, a bright and uplifting acoustic-pop background music track starts, featuring a prominent rhythmic piano melody, steady drum kit beats, and an upbeat tempo around 120 BPM. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect marks a transition to the next visual phase. The narrator's voice maintains high arousal and positive valence. The BGM continues seamlessly, providing a consistent high-energy atmosphere. There is a clean signal-to-noise ratio with no detectable environmental background noise. (3) As she mentions her morning routine, a quick liquid 'slurping' sound effect is heard, followed by a 'pop' sound. These SFX are clearly added in post-production for emphasis. The acoustic guitar rhythm in the BGM becomes more noticeable during brief pauses in speech. (4) Multiple 'whoosh' transition sound effects are interspersed between sentences, matching the fast visual cuts. The narrator's articulation is extremely clear and professional. The BGM's beat strength is moderate, providing a constant drive without overpowering the vocal tracks. (5) Tactile sound effects of skin being patted and product being squeezed from a tube are layered into the mix. These 'incidental' sounds are crisp and intentional. The music shifts slightly in tonality but remains in a bright major mode throughout the sequence. (6) A loud, percussive 'clack' sound occurs as a Mahjong tile hits the table, followed immediately by a pre-recorded applause and cheering SFX track. The narrator's voice becomes even more animated, reflecting a peak in emotional arousal and triumph. (7) The audio concludes with a final summary and promotional offer. The female voice remains authoritative and persuasive. The BGM reaches its finale with a short melodic flourish and then fades out quickly into studio silence, ending the audio track cleanly.
